meta.note: Initial community launch dataset. Dates and details below were checked against the linked official event pages on 4 November 2026.

events.title: Bajaj Pune Grand Tour 2027
events.description: Six-stage professional road race across Pune district. The official event website describes a UCI 2.1 race. Participation is through selected professional teams; Gran Fondo details were still to be confirmed on the official website when checked.
events.poster_note: No standalone poster URL was available on the official event page checked.

events.title: Tour of Thekkady 2027
events.location: Start: Caesar Palace Hotel, Nagampadom, Kottayam · Finish: Thekkady, Kerala
events.description: Sixth edition of the endurance cycling event. The organiser lists a 152 km race and a 167 km tour. Race categories include Men, Women and Masters; check the official terms for eligibility and cut-off times.
events.poster_note: The organiser page was available, but a direct poster image URL was not confirmed.

events.title: Race Across India 2027
events.description: The organiser's home page announces a 28 February 2027 start for its Srinagar-to-Kanyakumari ultra-cycling race (3,758 km). The event finish date is not stated on the page. The linked registration page still displays 2024-edition details, so current entry instructions have not been linked pending organiser confirmation.
